description: List tags globally or on a ticket; add, remove, or replace ticket tags. Replace with an empty list clears all tags. Add/remove read the full existing tag list first; concurrent tag changes may be overwritten.

action.description: Operation to perform; replace with an empty tags array clears all ticket tags.

page.description: Page to list; list action only.

pageSize.description: List page size, at most 100; list action only.

tags.description: Tag names for an update; required for add, remove, or replace. An empty list is allowed only for replace.

ticket.description: Ticket ID, number, or URL. Required for add, remove, and replace; optional for list.

name: freescout_tags
title: Manage FreeScout Tags
